arxiv-2101-10561.title: Stripe skyrmions and skyrmion crystals
arxiv-2101-10561.creator: X. R. Wang
arxiv-2101-10561.description: Abstract Skyrmions are important in topological quantum field theory for being soliton solutions of a nonlinear sigma model and in information technology for their attractive applications. Skyrmions are believed to be circular and stripy spin textures appeared in the vicinity of skyrmion crystals are termed spiral, helical, and cycloid spin orders, but not skyrmions.

arxiv-2105-01112.title: Tuple Interpretations for Higher-Order Complexity
arxiv-2105-01112.creator: Cynthia Kop, Deivid Vale
arxiv-2105-01112.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Cynthia Kop, Deivid Vale. We develop a class of algebraic interpretations for many-sorted and higher-order term rewriting systems that takes type information into account. Specifically, base-type terms are mapped to tuples of natural numbers and higher-order terms to functions between those tuples. Tuples may carry information relevant to the type; for instance, a term of type Nature {\rm Nature} may be associated to a pair ⟨ 𝖼𝗈𝗌𝗍 , 𝗌𝗂𝗓𝖾 ⟩ \langle\mathsf{cost},\mathsf{size}\rangle representing its evaluation cost and size.

arxiv-2112-13722.title: Chris Isham: mentor, colleague, friend.
arxiv-2112-13722.creator: M. J. Duff
arxiv-2112-13722.description: Abstract Imperial/TP/2021/mjd/2 Celebrating fifty years of collaboration and friendship with Chris Isham. 1 P. T. Matthews It was the day man landed on the moon. I received a telegram at my parents’ home in Manchester asking me to phone Prof. P. T Matthews at Imperial College London.

arxiv-2208-02403.title: Vibrotactile Feedback to Make Real Walking in Virtual Reality More Accessible
arxiv-2208-02403.creator: M. Rasel Mahmud, Michael Stewart, Alberto Cordova, and John Quarles
arxiv-2208-02403.description: Abstract This research aims to examine the effects of various vibrotactile feedback techniques on gait (i.e., walking patterns) in virtual reality (VR). Prior studies have demonstrated that gait disturbances in VR users are significant usability barriers. However, adequate research has not been performed to address this problem.

arxiv-2210-00815.title: Measurement of Trustworthiness of the Online Reviews
arxiv-2210-00815.creator: Dipankar Das
arxiv-2210-00815.description: Abstract In electronic commerce (e-commerce)markets, a decision-maker faces a sequential choice problem. Third-party intervention is essential in making purchase decisions in this choice process. For instance, while purchasing products/services online, a buyer’s choice or behavior is often affected by the overall reviewers’ ratings, feedback, etc. Moreover, the reviewer is also a decision-maker.

arxiv-2310-05509.title: Quartic rigid systems in the plane and in the Poincaré sphere
arxiv-2310-05509.creator: M.J. Álvarez, J.L. Bravo, L.A. Calderón*
arxiv-2310-05509.description: Abstract . We consider the planar family of rigid systems of the form x ′ = − y + x ​ P ​ ( x , y ) , y ′ = x + y ​ P ​ ( x , y ) x^{\prime}=-y+xP(x,y),y^{\prime}=x+yP(x,y) , where P P is any polynomial with monomials of degree one and three.

arxiv-2509-00511.title: Testing hydrodynamic response to initial-state geometry in Pb+ d ↑ d^{\uparrow} collisions
arxiv-2509-00511.creator: \firstname Heikki \lastname Mäntysaari, \firstname Björn \lastname Schenke, \firstname Chun \lastname Shen \fnsep, \firstname Wenbin \lastname Zhao
arxiv-2509-00511.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by \firstname Heikki \lastname Mäntysaari, \firstname Björn \lastname Schenke, \firstname Chun \lastname Shen \fnsep, \firstname Wenbin \lastname Zhao. Deuterons with different polarization states have distinct shapes for their wavefunctions. This offers a unique opportunity to experimentally control the initial-state collision geometry with the polarization of the light-ion targets in relativistic heavy-ion experiments. We study the charged hadron elliptic flow coefficients with respect to the polarization angle of deuterons in Pb + polarized deuteron collisions using a hydrodynamics + hadronic transport model.

arxiv-2510-10862.title: A Joint Learning Approach to Hardware Caching and Prefetching
arxiv-2510-10862.creator: Samuel Yuan, Divyanshu Saxena, Jiayi Chen, Nihal Sharma, Aditya Akella, [0.25em] The University of Texas at Austin
arxiv-2510-10862.description: Abstract Several learned policies have been proposed to replace heuristics for scheduling, caching, and other system components in modern systems. By leveraging diverse features, learning from historical trends, and predicting future behaviors, such models promise to keep pace with ever-increasing workload dynamism and continuous hardware evolution. However, policies trained in isolation may still achieve suboptimal performance when placed together.

doe-osti-3363717-energy-to-communities-e.creator: Unknown
doe-osti-3363717-energy-to-communities-e.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. In 2025, E2C provided customized technical assistance to representatives from 166 communities to improve reliability, affordability, and overall delivery of energy throughout the United States.

pmc-10514988.title: Retinal ganglion cell repopulation for vision restoration in optic neuropathy: a roadmap from the RReSTORe Consortium
pmc-10514988.creator: Jonathan R. Soucy, Erika A. Aguzzi, Julie Cho, Michael James Gilhooley, Casey Keuthan, Ziming Luo, Aboozar Monavarfeshani, Meher A. Saleem, Xue-Wei Wang, Juilette Wohlschlegel, Jonathan R. Soucy, Jonathan R. Soucy, Erika A. Aguzzi, Julie Cho, Michael James Gilhooley, Casey Keuthan, Ziming Luo, Abooz
pmc-10514988.description: Retinal ganglion cell (RGC) death in glaucoma and other optic neuropathies results in irreversible vision loss due to the mammalian central nervous system’s limited regenerative capacity. RGC repopulation is a promising therapeutic approach to reverse vision loss from optic neuropathies if the newly introduced neurons can reestablish functional retinal and thalamic circuits.

pmc-10546932.title: Secondary Infection Surveillance with Metagenomic Next-Generation Sequencing in COVID-19 Patients: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-10546932.creator: Renke Chen, Mengxiao Xie, Shenlong Wang, Fei Yu, Dan Zhang, Lingjun Yuan, Jieyuan Zheng, Jingchao Wang, Jieting Zhou, Binxiao Li, Shufa Zheng, Yongsheng Fan, Dongsheng Han
pmc-10546932.description: BackgroundMetagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) is a promising tool for improving antimicrobial therapy and infection control decision-making in complex infections. Secondary infection surveillance using mNGS in COVID-19 patients has rarely been reported.MethodsRespiratory pathogen and antibiotic resistance prediction were evaluated by BALF mNGS for 192 hospitalized COVID-19 patients between December 2022 and February 2023.ResultsSecondary infection was confirmed in 83.

pmc-10638011.title: Chinese students’ perceptions of social networks and their academic engagement in technology-enhanced classrooms
pmc-10638011.creator: Ting Yin, Jing Yin, Zhujun Xu
pmc-10638011.description: Using social networks as one of the new instruments of information and communication technologies in recent years has gained popularity. Social networks are used in various political, social, cultural, and educational fields. In education, students increasingly use social networks to create and maintain social relationships and support informal learning methods.

pmc-10642164.title: Evaluation of the Impact of Management Changes on Midwives’ Attitudes: A Questionnaire-Based Comparative Study in a a Women’s and Children’s Hospital in China: A Questionnaire-Based Study
pmc-10642164.creator: Zhuli Chen, Ming Huang, Guoyu Wang
pmc-10642164.description: BackgroundChange management has become an important tool for hospitals to continuously improve themselves in a competitive market. This questionnaire-based study aimed to compare the attitudes of 78 midwives before and after management changes in work schedules and performance-related pay between March and October 2022 at a women’s and children’s hospital in China.

pmc-11001328.title: Research progress of natural active compounds on improving podocyte function to reduce proteinuria in diabetic kidney disease
pmc-11001328.creator: Le Gong, Rui Wang, Xinyu Wang, Jing Liu, Zhaodi Han, Qian Li, Yi Jin, Hui Liao
pmc-11001328.description: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is a primary cause of end-stage renal disease. Proteinuria is a clinical indicator of the different stages of DKD, and podocyte injury is a major cause of proteinuria. Podocyte-specific proteins (PSPs) play important roles in the normal filtration of podocytes.

pmc-11313810.title: Effects of Milk and Dairy on the Risk and Course of Inflammatory Bowel Disease versus Patients’ Dietary Beliefs and Practices: A Systematic Review
pmc-11313810.creator: Radoslaw Kempinski, Damian Arabasz, Katarzyna Neubauer
pmc-11313810.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: The role of the environment in the pathogenesis of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is undisputed, especially in light of numerous epidemiological data showing the increasing prevalence of IBD worldwide. Although no specific environmental factors have been identified, the diet has received the most attention as a potential modifier of the onset and course of IBD and as a therapeutic intervention.

pmc-11353559.title: Adolescent Health and Dark Personalities: The Role of Socioeconomic Status, Sports, and Cyber Experiences
pmc-11353559.creator: Ilrang Lee, Yonghwan Chang, Ye Lei, Taewoong Yoo, Peter Smith
pmc-11353559.description: By investigating the impact of dark personality traits on adolescent health, this study explores the interplay among economic disadvantage, spectator sports involvement, and cyber victimization. We analyzed data from 1844 students aged 13–17 in a school district in the USA, and our findings reveal positive associations between economic disadvantage and both Machiavellianism and psychopathy, influencing negative emotions-driven eating.

pmc-11683801.title: Modular Augmented Arthroplasty System to Manage Larger Bone Defects in the Ankle: A Case Series
pmc-11683801.creator: Rebecca Martin, Michael Dean, An Murty, Rajesh Kakwani, Ian Sharpe, David Townshend
pmc-11683801.description: Category:Ankle Arthritis; AnkleIntroduction/Purpose:Large bone defects such as those encountered after failed total ankle replacement have previously been a relative contraindication to revision ankle replacement due to inadequate bone stock. We describe our early experience and patient reported outcomes with a modular ankle replacement system with tibial and talar augments.

pmc-12577578.title: Systematic Review of Clinical Practice Guidelines for Post-Cataract Surgery Endophthalmitis Prophylaxis from 2008-2023
pmc-12577578.creator: Nuntachai Surawatsatien, Pimpetch Kasetsuwan, Jipada Pruksacholavit, Sunee Chansangpetch, Wasee Tulvatana, Pear Ferreira Pongsachareonnont, Paweena Susantitaphong, Usanee Reinprayoon
pmc-12577578.description: Postoperative endophthalmitis remains a significant concern following cataract surgery with a potential for severe vision loss. Although numerous clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) have been published worldwide, they offer differing recommendations for prophylactic measures. This systematic review aimed to synthesize and evaluate existing guidelines for endophthalmitis prophylaxis after cataract surgery. A comprehensive search including citation and gray literature search was conducted.

pmc-12712692.title: Porcine decellularized splenic matrix hydrogel-based vesicle sustained-release System: A dual-regulatory biomaterial for accelerated wound healing via angiogenesis and immune remodeling
pmc-12712692.creator: Peng Peng, Siyuan Fan, Peisheng Liu, Xiaoyao Huang, Zilin Xuan, Anqi Liu, Meiling Wu, Bingdong Sui, Bin Ye, Sha Zhang, Hao Guo
pmc-12712692.description: Wound healing involves a complex cascade of regenerative processes, particularly angiogenesis and immunomodulation, the orchestration of which is highly important for efficient repair of tissue defects. However, there is currently a lack of feasible strategies to coordinate angiogenesis and immunomodulation during cutaneous wound management, leading to non-healed skin defects a persistent clinical challenge.

pmc-12836930.title: Mediating role of aging and obesity in the relationship between dietary index for gut microbiota and metabolic syndrome and its potential regulatory mechanisms
pmc-12836930.creator: Han Yang, Shuang Zhao, Haijuan Zhao, Zhaojun Pang, Huiqing Yao, Xin Wang
pmc-12836930.description: BackgroundThe relationship between gut microbiota and metabolic syndrome (MetS) has attracted significant attention, with MetS comprising components like abdominal obesity, dysglycemia, dyslipidemia, and hypertension. The dietary index for gut microbiota (DI-GM) has also been developed as a standardized tool for assessing a balanced diet for the gut microbiota.

pmc-13385248.title: Genetic variability of blainvillea yellow spot virus (Begomovirus blainvilleae) reveals recombinant variants and a distinct nonanucleotide motif
pmc-13385248.creator: Marcelo H. O. Gonçalves, Ayane F. F. Quadros, Mayra M. M. Ferro, Anelise F. Orílio, João Paulo H. Silva, Julia B. Lage, Sarah J. C. Silva, F. Murilo Zerbini
pmc-13385248.description: Viruses from wild plants may emerge as new economically important agricultural pathogens through spillover events. Blainvillea yellow spot virus (Begomovirus blainvilleae, BlYSV) is a bipartite geminivirus which is ubiquitous in the non-cultivated plant Blainvillea rhomboidea. To better understand the ecological and evolutionary aspects of this virus, we sampled B. rhomboidea in three Brazilian states between 2020 and 2023.

uslaw-usc-t16-s1411.title: 16 U.S.C. § 1411 — Findings and policy
uslaw-usc-t16-s1411.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s1411.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 31 (Marine Mammal Protection); Subchapter IV (International Dolphin Conservation Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Findings The Congress finds the following: (1) The yellowfin tuna fishery of the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean has resulted in the deaths of millions of dolphins. (2) Significant awareness and increased concern for the health and safety of dolphin.
